claim: No numeric Codex crowdsourced allowance claim can be supported from the TiboTattle homepage as accessed on 2026-10-05 because its rendered panel was still checking and showed no numerical series.
scope: Observed page state at retrieval only; not evidence that no value has ever been published. An earlier unverified availability label was not reproduced and has been removed.

claim: TiboTattle's aggregate is an API-price-equivalent estimate and should not be described as an official ChatGPT allowance or bill.
TiboTattle aggregate interpretation has meaningful sample and overlap limitations: a single-source daily view may be shown, and separate installs can overlap.
scope: Publisher disclosure, not independent audit of submissions.

claim: OpenUsage, CodexBar, CUStats, SessionWatcher, AIUsage, and ccusage are useful adjacent tools, but their reviewed sources describe account-specific direct signals and/or local token/cost processing rather than a public crowdsourced Codex allowance aggregate.
scope: Based on primary sources reviewed; not an exhaustive market census.

claim: A tracker’s live personal provider/API signal, a TiboTattle crowdsourced aggregate, and a local token/cost estimate are distinct measurement classes and should not be combined as if they were the same quota measure.
scope: Methodological synthesis from publisher descriptions and current OpenAI help guidance.

claim: OpenAI directs users to account-specific usage views and says limits vary by plan; that policy guidance is not a population usage report.
scope: Current official help page accessed on 2026-10-05.

claim: The expanded discovery set includes adjacent cross-device and account-level usage apps surfaced in Apple listings, with capability/data-source descriptions attributed to their publishers; their listings provide no evidence of a public crowdsourced Codex allowance aggregate.
scope: Publisher listings reviewed on 2026-10-05; not an exhaustive directory search and not evidence about every app capability.

claim: The discovery set contains eleven distinct products: TiboTattle and ten adjacent tracker or local usage-monitor products.
scope: Count of products in the report table only; not an exhaustive app-market count.

claim: TiboTattle's own privacy page describes the provenance and identity limits of the community sample; it does not establish that the sample is representative or independently verify the submissions.
scope: Publisher disclosure as accessed on 2026-10-05; no independent audit performed.

claim: The direct community post is used only to substantiate TiboTattle as a product-discovery lead; no quantities from it support Codex allowance claims.
scope: Discovery-only use; the direct page's relative-time label does not establish a calendar publication date.
